title: SAGE-PAIR: Source-Pretrained Routed Residual Adaptation for Sparse-Feedback Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommendation systems often enter a new serving window before enough outcomes are available to retrain the deployed model. We study this regime with 0.05-1.0% target feedback, a range that spans our stress tests while keeping supervision far below the degrees of freedom of the source recommender. At this scale, existing fine-tuning and meta-learning methods still estimate target-specific updates from extremely sparse feedback, leaving the update direction weakly identified. SAGE-PAIR instead transfers a source-supported residual correction space and only calibrates this space using target outcomes. We introduce SAGE-PAIR, a staged adapter that pretrains a low-dimensional global residual on an adjacent source period and adds a soft router over residual experts conditioned on source user profiles. translated_abstract: 推荐系统常常在足够的结果数据可用于重新训练已部署模型之前，就进入了新的服务窗口。我们在0.05-1.0%目标反馈的范围内研究这一情形，该范围涵盖了我们的压力测试，同时使监督信号远低于源推荐器的自由度。在这种规模下，现有的微调和元学习方法仍然从极其稀疏的反馈中估计目标特定的更新，导致更新方向辨识度较弱。SAGE-PAIR则转而迁移一个由源数据支持的残差校正空间，并仅使用目标结果来校准该空间。我们提出SAGE-PAIR，这是一种分阶段适配器：它在相邻的源时期上预训练一个低维全局残差，并添加一个以源用户画像为条件的残差专家软路由器。目标反馈随后校准这一残差状态，而不是重新学习推荐器。在KuaiSAR-v2的锁定测试集划分上，SAGE-PAIR（Fu……
tldr: 提出SAGE-PAIR，通过在源时期预训练低维残差校正空间并以源用户画像为条件添加软路由专家机制，仅需0.05-1.0%的稀疏目标反馈即可校准残差状态而无需重新学习推荐器，有效解决了极端稀疏反馈下更新方向辨识度弱的问题。
en_tdlr: SAGE-PAIR introduces a staged adapter that pretrains a low-dimensional global residual on a source period with a soft router over residual experts, calibrating this residual state with only 0.05-1.0% target feedback instead of relearning the recommender under extremely sparse supervision.
